description: Food assistance for families with school-aged children.
whatThisIs: Food assistance for families with school-aged children.
whoItHelps: Families who rely on school lunches and are looking for extra food support for their children.
Families with school aged children who are currently receiving SNAP, DTA cash benefits, certain types of MassHealth coverage, SSI with a relative caregiver, or is in foster care.
whatToKnow: The SUN Bucks program automatically enrolls some individuals, but you may also apply on the DTA’s website.
The SUN Bucks application does not close once summer begins. The summer 2026 application closed September 6th 2026. The summer 2027 portal had already opened for applications.
name: SUN Bucks
